tooling.cmake_version: not invoked by this static inventory
tooling.source_selection: Recursive benchmarks/**/*.cpp whose basename starts with bench or benchmark_, equals llm_bench.cpp, or ends with _bench.cpp.
tooling.module_assignment: The first benchmark-relative path component must match an immediate directory under src/; all other benchmark sources are listed as unassigned.

findings.message: 1 benchmark source(s) not registered in CMake
findings.remediation: Add source to benchmarks/CMakeLists.txt or module subdirectory CMakeLists.txt using themis_add_standard_benchmark()

findings.message: 8 CTest entry(ies) reference benchmark target(s) without source mapping
findings.remediation: Either register the benchmark source in CMake or remove the orphaned CTest entry

ci_workflows.purpose: Weekly benchmark build/run and comparison; schedule and manual dispatch
PR benchmark source/CTest registration audit; does not execute benchmark workloads
ci_workflows.trigger: pull_request on benchmark source/CMake paths; workflow_dispatch

latest_ci_attempt.note: CMake configuration failed because RocksDB was not found; build and benchmark execution were skipped, so no result artifact exists.

status_legend.covered: A retained, successful benchmark result and required workload metadata are present.
status_legend.gap: Source/target/CTest mapping or claim applicability/evidence is missing.
status_legend.not applicable: A specific, source-backed non-applicability rationale has been reviewed.
status_legend.blocked: Execution/evidence cannot be established because a required run or external condition is blocked.

release_claims.claim: LIMIT 10 at 100,000 and 10,000,000 rows must bound latency and peak memory.
release_claims.measurement_scope: Synthetic pull-source only; not a storage scan or retained raw result.

required_workload.correctness_checks: Verify LIMIT 10 returns the expected ten rows.

release_claims.evidence_note: The merged PR reports synthetic pull-source measurements, not a storage scan, and does not attach a retained raw result artifact.
release_claims.follow_up: Run the 100K/10M workload against the production scan path; retain raw JSON, latency, peak-memory, configuration, and correctness evidence.

release_claims.claim: Performance instrumentation and regression thresholds are reproducible and noise-aware.
release_claims.evidence_note: The owner issue remains open; no current run/result evidence was verified.
release_claims.follow_up: Close the issue's methodology and baseline tasks, including an explicit noise policy and maintainer-approved thresholds.

release_claims.claim: Wave A release-critical hardware baselines include reproducible workload and p95/p99 evidence.
release_claims.target: v2.5.0 M0 / Wave A exit criteria
release_claims.evidence_note: The merged refresh explicitly leaves transaction, GPU, voice, sharding, and replication measurements pending; its latest baseline job was skipped and the referenced artifact is absent.
release_claims.follow_up: Run the existing Wave A lanes on representative hardware and attach run URL, source SHA, configuration, raw result, and summary before promotion.

release_claims.claim: GPU capability and fallback behavior is measured on supported hardware and distinguishes CPU degradation.

required_workload.correctness_checks: Exercise GPU success, unavailable-device fallback, and forced failure.

release_claims.evidence_note: The GPU-specific capability/fallback evidence issue remains open; hardware evidence is not available.
release_claims.follow_up: Capture CPU-only and GPU-capable lane results with hardware metadata, fallback mode, and valid benchmark exit status.

release_claims.claim: “1,024 concurrent requests on a single GPU”
release_claims.evidence_note: The merged PR removes the unsupported concurrency claim; no hardware result is claimed, so a benchmark is not applicable to the withdrawn statement.
